patch_description: Restore the pre/post RZ layer separation that was critical in Prior 2, which achieved 0.58 score. Over-aggressive RZ parameter sharing in the current program (merging all RZ into one parameter) has degraded performance to 0.46. Additionally, implement moderate parameter sharing in the entanglement layer: share XX gate parameters between positions (0,1) and (6,7) as a single parameter, share YY gate parameters between (2,3) and (1,4) as a single parameter, while keeping the two ZZ parameters distinct. This balances expressivity with parameter efficiency (8 distinct params vs current 6), targeting the sweet spot that Prior 2 found.
